articles.title: Can Sánchez convince Spanish voters he is their best hope for fairer housing?
articles.summary:
Recent death of 87-year-old woman likely to focus attention on crisis in run-up to general election at end of November

  • Europe live – latest updates

Even before María del Carmen Abascal died on Wednesday night, a mere fortnight after her eviction from the Madrid flat where she had lived for most of her life, the frail 87-year-old woman had become the enduring face of Spain’s housing crisis.

Her plight – and the wider issue it embodied – had led to street demonstrations, the creation of a protest camp in the middle of the Spanish capital, and spurred the socialist-led government to propose emergency measures to facilitate and protect access to housing. When rightwing and far-right parties voted down those measures in congress last week, the prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, responded by announcing a snap general election for the end of November.

articles.title: Russian attack on bus kills at least 30 people near Ukraine frontline
articles.summary:
Governor says Kremlin ‘deliberately targeting civilians’ after strike in Kramatorsk, which also wounded 18 and set second bus on fire

  • Europe live – latest updates

A Russian missile strike on a bus in the eastern city of Kramatorsk has killed at least 30 people, officials said on Thursday, in one of the worst attacks by Moscow on Ukrainian civilians this year.

The regional prosecutor’s office in the Donetsk region said the vehicle had been hit at 10am by an aerial bomb. “As of now, the death toll from this morning’s attack has risen to 30. Eighteen people were wounded,” it said, adding that all local public transport had been suspended.

articles.title: Good night, and good lick: what can we expect from George Clooney’s restaurant?
articles.summary:
The newly-official French citizen is planning to open an Italian restaurant in Provence. Will it float like his tequila brand or sink as swiftly as the Steven Spielberg submarine eatery that made one reviewer ‘embarrassed to be human’?

The Provençal village of Cotignac is not wanting for places to eat. Within a short drive of its pale stone houses, you can find a wealth of high-end dining options. La Table de Mentone, set within the beautiful Château Mentone wine estate, is famed for the produce it grows on site. The Michelin-starred Restaurant Bruno offers dazzling variations of truffle dishes. More locally, Picotte Provence offers the sort of charming village dining that showcases the best of what the region has to offer.

However, despite all these wonderful options, there is one thing that Cotignac does not yet boast, and that’s a celebrity vanity project. But that is all about to change, thanks to the news that George Clooney is planning to open a restaurant there.

archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající tlak na dluhopisové trhy kvůli francouzské rozpočtové krizi a zvýšenou volatilitu před španělskými volbami.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent pressure on bond markets due to the French budget crisis and heightened volatility ahead of Spanish elections are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí eskalaci hybridních hrozeb včetně útoků námořních dronů v Černém moři a vnitřním bezpečnostním rizikům, jako jsou masové protivládní protesty ve Francii. Politickou nestabilitu prohlubují vládní krize v Rumunsku a rostoucí napětí kolem obchodních jednání s Čínou ohledně dovozu elektromobilů.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing an escalation of hybrid threats, including naval drone attacks in the Black Sea and internal security risks such as mass anti-government protests in France. Political instability is deepening due to government crises in Romania and rising tensions surrounding trade talks with China over electric vehicle imports.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající napětí na trzích v reakci na eskalaci geopolitických střetů a pokračující protivládní nepokoje ve Francii.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent market tension is expected in response to escalating geopolitical clashes and ongoing anti-government unrest in France.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se bezpečnostním rizikům kvůli pokračujícím brutálním ruským útokům na ukrajinskou civilní a energetickou infrastrukturu. V samotné EU roste napětí vlivem násilných studentských nepokojů ve Francii, rostoucího tlaku čínské konkurence na automobilový sektor a obav z hrozících hybridních útoků.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing escalating security risks due to ongoing brutal Russian strikes on Ukrainian civilian and energy infrastructure. Within the EU, tensions are mounting driven by violent student protests in France, growing pressure from Chinese competition on the automotive sector, and fears of looming hybrid attacks.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající napětí na trzích v reakci na eskalaci geopolitických střetů, bezpečnostní incidenty a pokračující protivládní nepokoje ve Francii.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent market tension is expected in response to escalating geopolitical clashes, security incidents, and ongoing anti-government unrest in France.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci eskalujícího geopolitického napětí, pokračující války na Ukrajině a vnitřních politicko-sociálních krizí od Francie přes Polsko po Itálii. Ekonomické trhy nervózně sledují rostoucí výnosy dluhopisů, fiskální tlaky v klíčových zemích a napjaté obchodní vztahy s Čínou.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a combination of escalating geopolitical tensions, the ongoing war in Ukraine, and internal political and social crises ranging from France and Poland to Italy. Economic markets are nervously monitoring rising bond yields, fiscal pressures in key countries, and tense trade relations with China.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající volatilitu na trzích v důsledku geopolitického napětí a nejistoty kolem fiskální stability vybraných členských států.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent market volatility is expected due to geopolitical tensions and uncertainty surrounding the fiscal stability of selected member states.
